notes: `guard !slots.isEmpty else { return nil }` (line 130) returns immediately when loadSlots produced no usable entries at all -- whether because world_slots/ is missing, present-but-empty, or every slot.json inside it failed to parse (loadSlots's own tolerant skip, characterized in load-slots-corrupt-entry-skipped.json, can itself reduce a non-empty directory to this state). There is no recorded active slot to resolve; downstream reconciliation must not invent one.
